sn22.31:1.1: Tatra || voca || || Aghañ ca bhikkhave desissāmi aghamūlañ ca || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamañca bhikkhave aghaṃ || || Rūpam bhikkhave aghaṃ || vedanā aghaṃ || saññā aghaṃ || saṅkhārā aghaṃ || viññāṇam aghaṃ || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave aghaṃ || || Katamañ ca bhikkhave aghamūlaṃ || || Yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatra tatrābhinandinī || seyyathīdaṃ Kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave aghamūlan ti || || Sāvatthi || ||
